# Bundled search dependency

`fuse.basic.min.js` is Fuse.js **7.0.0**, copied without byte changes from
`assets/js/fuse.basic.min.js` in
[PaperMod commit 3e5362100777a9426e05ef30e972800cabb54f21](https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod/tree/3e5362100777a9426e05ef30e972800cabb54f21).
It is kept locally so search does not depend on a theme checkout or CDN.

- SHA-256: `d42fa2fe333d0ce3d9369962cba1da9b205e4fb3406d80fc89199c6766e8a666`
- Upstream: [Fuse.js v7.0.0](https://github.com/krisk/Fuse/tree/v7.0.0)
- Fuse uses Apache License 2.0; its original file header is retained and the
  [upstream license](https://github.com/krisk/Fuse/blob/v7.0.0/LICENSE) is included
  as `Fuse-LICENSE`.
- `PaperMod-LICENSE` retains the MIT notice for the source theme. It does not
  replace Fuse's Apache license.
